Bidur farm and Trishuli farm can't be reached: the only roads to them lead through Tarkeshwar care home, and its road to Suryagadhi temple is buried. Those three adults are deferred.

I treated the flooded roads, where a truck was swept away, as unusable. I did not use Tadi temple as a drop-off, since it isn't designated.

Driving comes to 180 minutes (car1 114, car2 66). Deferring three adults adds 60.

COST: 240
